name: Perch AI Starter
free_limit: Free Starter includes 20,000 PT (up to US$20 of Perch-hosted model usage) per calendar month, resetting in UTC; Web, Desktop and CLI access.
watch_out: No direct public API access; hosted models and limits may change. Starter Data Program is enabled by default but can be disabled in Privacy settings. No overage charges; usage may pause or be throttled at limits. BYOK inference costs are separate. Commercial-use permission for Starter is not explicitly confirmed.
